title: cleanup window: retry firing mid-cleanup can leak an SCHC fragment session
description: Codereview of 2kem (round 3, robustness, surfaced via security pass): _cleanup_started cancels fragment sessions (node.py ~823) BEFORE capability-retry tasks (~850). A retry whose sleep expires inside that window legitimately calls send() (pre-shutdown transmissions are allowed) and, for a packet needing fragmentation, opens an _OutboundFragmentSession AFTER the fragment-cancel snapshot — that session outlives cleanup with its timer task never cancelled. Fix: run _cancel_fragment_sessions again after the retry-cancel block, or cancel retries before fragment sessions (accepting that pre-shutdown retry sends may be cut off).
